integrity.computational_evidence: Finite exact enumeration for 17 small prime-square instances and 5 independent conditional checks; not a replacement for proof.
integrity.mathematical_proof: Self-contained conditional lifting, polynomial Euler-product, moment and stabilization arguments.

scientific_limitations: Univariate monic polynomials modulo a prime square only; excludes unrestricted coefficients, higher powers, multivariable models and actual p-adic zeros. A literature search cannot establish absolute historical priority.
title: An exact prime-square root law and sharp stabilization degree for random monic polynomials
